verdict.rationale: Aleph is an AI-native FP&A platform with built-in AI agents, so a commitment or control preventing customer data from being used for model training is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains nothing on that point. The nearby items are adjacent controls and earn no credit: encryption, access permissions, audit logs, and deleting data when cancelling a trial. The 'train your agents' wording refers to prompt configuration, not a training opt-out.
